description: This file contains unit tests for the ConditionServiceImpl class within the OpenMRS project, specifically testing CRUD operations, querying, and status changes of Condition objects in the healthcare data model.

classes.name: ConditionServiceImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the implementation of ConditionService in the OpenMRS project, containing tests for saving, retrieving, voiding/unvoiding, and deleting Condition objects.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldSaveNewCondition
methods.description: Tests saving a new Condition object and verifies that it is correctly persisted with the specified properties.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldReplaceExistingCondition
methods.description: Tests updating an existing condition (by UUID), ensuring the old is voided and a new one is created with the updated properties.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldRetainPropertiesOfCondition
methods.description: Verifies that various properties of a Condition object are correctly saved and retrieved, including related entities and date fields.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldNotVoidAndRecreateIfUnchanged
methods.description: Ensures saving an unmodified condition does not create duplicates or void the existing record.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldVoidExistingConditionAndNotCreateNewCondition
methods.description: Tests void functionality where an existing condition is marked void, maintaining data consistency.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldUnvoidExistingVoidedCondition
methods.description: Tests unvoiding a previously voided condition, ensuring the condition is restored properly.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldSaveConditionAssociatedWithAnEncounter
methods.description: Verifies that conditions linked with encounters are saved correctly, and that the encounter association persists.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldSaveConditionWithFormField
methods.description: Tests saving a condition that uses form namespace and path fields, checking correct concatenation and persistence.

methods.name: getConditionByUuid_shouldFindConditionGivenValidUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Condition by UUID and verifies correctness.

methods.name: getConditionByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoObjectFoundWithGivenUuid
methods.description: Ensures that requesting a non-existent UUID returns null.

methods.name: getCondition_shouldFindConditionGivenValidId
methods.description: Retrieves a Condition by its internal database ID.

methods.name: getActiveConditions_shouldGetActiveConditions
methods.description: Tests retrieval of active conditions for a specific patient.

methods.name: getAllConditions_shouldGetAllUnvoidedConditions
methods.description: Ensures that all non-voided conditions for a patient are retrieved.

methods.name: getConditionsByEncounter_shouldGetAllConditionsAssociatedWithAnEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves all conditions linked to a specific encounter.

methods.name: voidCondition_shouldVoidConditionSuccessfully
methods.description: Marks a condition as voided with a reason, setting appropriate fields.

methods.name: unvoidCondition_shouldUnvoidConditionSuccessfully
methods.description: Removes void status from a condition, restoring prior state.

methods.name: purgeCondition_shouldPurgeCondition
methods.description: Deletes/removes a condition from the database entirely.
